edit.statement: Being an authorized signer on an account held at a bank, rather than owning it, is what gives a person an account at that bank.
edit.subject: ownsAccount ; accountHeldAt → hasAccountAt
edit.original: Owning an account that is held at a bank means having an account at that bank.
edit.scope: An account is held at a bank; originally, owning it is what gives a person an account at that bank.
